<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0042026-03-0315-27-42" status="reviewed"><note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3834">rgya°</rs></note> yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3834">kha 1</rs> na re tha snyad <choice><reg>sgrub kyi bsgrub bya</reg><orig>sgrub ‹kyi sgrub› bya</orig></choice> ni cha 2 <lb n="11b4"/> su gnas te | ji ltar na dpe' dang rtsod gzhi'i nog lkog shal 2 ba lang gi brda'i rgyu mtshan du mi 'dra ba bkag pa'i med dgag ni mi slu ba'i bsgrub bya yin te | med dgag de don la gnas pa'i phyir ro || dpe' dang rtsod gzhi'i ba lang <abbr>thams cad</abbr> nog lkog shal gyi brda'i rgyu mtshan can du 'dra bar blos bzung pa ni rlom yul gyi bsgrub bya bsgrub chos yin te ¦
               <lb n="11b5"/> yul dus rang bzhin tha dad <choice><reg>kyi</reg><orig>kyi×</orig></choice> ba lang <abbr>thams cad</abbr> shog lkog shal gyi rgyu mtshan can du blos bzung yang bsgrub chos de lta bu 'dra ba don la mi gnas pa'i phyir ro || 
               khyab pa nges byed kyang dpe' nag sgur la mtshan nyid rtogs pa tsam gyi rtog pa rang ka bas brda' btags pas khyab pa mngon suM gyis grub po || des na skabs kyi nyes pa las grol ste | khyab <lb n="11b6"/> pa nges par byed pa'i tshad ma yod pas rjes dpag du 'dus pa'i phyir ro ||</seg></TEI>
